cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Make the Choice Rewrite the Past
cards.instruction: Make them choose between options whose consequences reinterpret an earlier promise, refusal, or agreement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Keep my spare key or return it. Either choice explains last week's 'take some space.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Then keeping it can mean the evening ended.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Would make that evening the beginning of something neither of us named.
